summary: Round 88 P0 verification: BOTH backend + frontend testing. All 4 fixes work end-to-end. Backend: 4/4 pytest pass (subcategoria auto-detect, PUT no-wipe, sync commessa on PUT, infissi_extras persist). Frontend: Composite editor opens infisso configurator pre-populated with existing measure (120x140), select-on-focus replaces value instantly (typing 150 -> 150, not 120150), zanzariera toggle persists, row updates with new measure in name (150x140) after Salva. Listini Fornitori dashboard shows correct macro-categoria hierarchy (Porte interne FIRST, then Porte blindate). API filter by categoria correctly uses subcategoria_effettiva: 'Porta Matriz Noce' put in a 'porte_blindate' listino is auto-reclassified and appears ONLY under porte_interne filter, NOT under porte_blindate. 'Porta Blindata RC2' stays in porte_blindate. All data-testid expected by review are present.

issues: Cosmetic: in the visible row badge the title cache showed '120x140cm' briefly while detail line had updated '150x140' — UI text is internally consistent after re-render; non-blocking.

console_warnings: React warning: 'A component is changing a controlled input to be uncontrolled' triggered in PreventivoComposite when infissi_meta fields toggle between defined/undefined. Non-blocking but worth a defensive fix (default values via ?? '' or ?? 0).

action_items: Optional polish: silence the React 'controlled->uncontrolled' warning in InfissoQuickConfigurator / PreventivoComposite by ensuring `it.larghezza ?? ''` style defaults so the input never receives `undefined`. Not user-facing but pollutes console.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend riclassifica returns `cambi_per_categoria: {}` even when reclassification occurred — semantics: it counts ONLY products whose stored `categoria` field changed; products with auto-detected `subcategoria_effettiva` differing from listino do not increment this counter. Filter works correctly via subcategoria_effettiva at query time, but the response message can mislead admin. Consider exposing `n_prodotti_riclassificati` separately.

Frontend: routes use kebab-less form '/adminlistinifornitori' which is non-standard. Sidebar link works but direct URL navigation requires the concatenated form. Consider also exposing '/admin/listini-fornitori' for SEO/readability.
Test data hygiene: TEST_ prefixed fornitori/listini created during pytest runs are cleaned up in fixtures but a few stale TEST entries may exist from previous rounds — non-blocking.
seed_data_creation: Test created and deleted: 1 preventivo composite with 1 infisso (id inf-test-r88), 1 listino porte_blindate with 'Porta Matriz Noce' + 'Porta Blindata RC2 stark'. Both cleaned up.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Round 88 fully verified. All P0 user complaints (modifica preventivo + sync commessa, Porta Matriz incorrect under blindate, infissi non-modificabili in preventivo esistente, UX misure with select-on-focus) RESOLVED. The infissi configurator now correctly supports mode='edit' with initialItems. The route to Listini Fornitori is `/adminlistinifornitori`. Only minor issue: React controlled-input warning in console (harmless).
